lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I put all five on one page. Mine has a chart.
lines.script: [reporting, proud] I put all five on one page. [bragging] Mine has a CHART.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Can I have a copy for tab four?
lines.script: [hopeful, asking nicely] Can I have a copy for tab four?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: You can have a copy. The chart stays with me.
lines.script: [granting it] You can have a copy. [laying down the terms] The CHART stays with me.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: ...Can I keep the binder?
lines.script: [small, hopeful] ...Can I keep the binder?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: It's yours. I made it for you. Your name is on the spine.
lines.script: [giving it, fond] It's yours. [admitting] I made it for you. [tender] Your name is on the spine.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: My name is on the SPINE!
lines.script: [punchline, shouting] My name is on the SPINE!
